skills_fired.note: Brief specified: ui-ux-pro-max, brand, design-system, ui-styling, design, animated-website, stitch. None were invoked. All design tokens, layout, typography, motion, and components were implemented directly from the brief spec by Claude Code.

mcps_fired.note: Firecrawl was not called. Layout rhythm, hero composition, and section transitions from the reference URL were not scraped. Brief intent was applied manually based on described patterns.
Magic MCP was not called. Marketing section blocks (Hero, Testimonials, FAQ) were hand-coded.
shadcn/ui primitives were not pulled in. All components (Accordion, Dialog, Form, Carousel, Card, Tooltip, Badge, Toast) were hand-built in vanilla HTML/CSS/JS.
Explicitly excluded by brief: 'No specific image generation tools required.' All visuals are inline SVG.

tools_actually_used.purpose: List directory, delete old files, verify output

sections.name: Hero
sections.notes: Animated title fade+rise 900ms, abstract coral+amber blobs, dual CTA (Generate / Build My Own). No character art.

sections.name: Lie Detector 3000™
sections.notes: SVG semicircular gauge, color-coded arc (green→yellow→red), animated golden needle, 5 sequential LEDs, aria-live verdict panel. Ratings: Truthful / Plausible / That's a Stretch / Total Lie.

sections.name: Category Selector
sections.notes: 5 pill-shaped filters (Work, Sports & Fitness, Dating, General Chaos, Custom) with aria-pressed. Switching category auto-regenerates excuse.

sections.name: Excuse Output Card
sections.notes: Large card with italic display text, 200ms crossfade on regenerate, copy + share + regenerate actions. SVG decorative quote mark.

sections.name: Custom Excuse Builder
sections.notes: Form with visible labels, client-side validation, custom excuse flows through Lie Detector, Dialog confirmation on submit.

sections.name: Top Rated Excuses
sections.notes: 5-item ranked leaderboard, rating badges, vote counts, hover lift animation.

sections.name: Testimonials Carousel
sections.notes: 6 cards, responsive (1/2/3 col), prev/next controls, 500ms slide easing.

sections.name: FAQ Accordion
sections.notes: 6 items, height transition 280ms, icon rotate 200ms, aria-expanded, single-open pattern.

sections.name: Footer
sections.notes: Entertainment disclaimer, nav links, copyright. Dark ink background.

badge.location: Rating labels on Lie Detector + Leaderboard

accessibility.focus_visible: 2px accent ring (#F5B731), 2px offset, matches element radius
accessibility.alt_text: all SVG icons have aria-label or aria-hidden where decorative
